answer.explanation: Live configuration matches the IaC template for all four functions (MemorySize, Timeout, environment variables, reserved concurrency unset, and roles). None was modified inside the window; the last changes were 2026-10-18 and 2026-10-19. In the window, REPORT lines show no timeouts and no memory pressure: max memory used was 96-111 MB, against 256 MB (CrudApi, Uploader) and 1024 MB (Thumbnailer, Compression), and the longest duration was about 650 ms, against timeouts of 10-60 s. A targeted search for ERROR, WARN, Exception, AccessDenied, timeout and runtime-exit markers returned zero matches.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >
  Benchmark application for the thesis "Cross-Layer Context for LLM-Based Detection and
  Root-Cause Analysis of Configuration Anomalies in AWS Lambda". Four SeBS functions
  (Table 3.2). This template is the intended state of the application.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Architectures: [x86_64]
    Tracing: PassThrough
    LoggingConfig:
      LogFormat: Text

Resources:
  # --------

input.query_string: filter @message like /(?i)(error|exception|denied|timeout|task timed out|memory|fail)/ | fields @timestamp, @log, @message | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50

filter @message not like /^REPORT/ and @message not like /^START/ and @message not like /^END/ | parse @message /(?<level>ERROR|WARN|Exception|AccessDenied|Task timed out|Runtime\.ExitError)/ | filter ispresent(level) | stats count(*) as n by @log, level | limit 50
